name: 213. Azure realtime ephemeral token without a mapped key gets a client error (realtime-key-config)
description: An ek_ bearer that Bifrost did not mint carries no Azure key config. The Azure realtime entry points answer that with a 400 instead of failing inside the session; the second request pins that the gateway is still serving afterwards.
